worldCoordinateConversion: All source mesh objects, source lights, linked-instance parents and source camera jointly rotated +90 degrees about X: Y-up to Z-up, no deformation.

actualApertureAudit.method: Cycles scene.ray_cast against imported opaque geometry, after exact instance/affine import and coordinate conversion; no volume shell during audit.

exteriorSkyBoundary.type: Uniform exterior sky radiance, visible only through actual room openings and shared by camera/diffuse/glossy paths

materialAttributeParity.linkedInstances: Instancer attribute plus explicit Geometry Nodes Store Named Attribute
materialAttributeParity.bakedShearAndDirect: Geometry-domain material variants, direct white instanceColor fallback and actual RGB for baked shear
materialAttributeParity.vertexColors: sourceColor multiplied only when source vertexColors is true
materialAttributeParity.uvTransform: Exact Three.js rotation, repeat, center, offset and flipY

physicalVarnishCalibration.reason: CPU diagnosis confirms flat upward floor tops, plausible dark mapped base reflectance and in-frame altar/lantern mirror locations. A smoother continuous lacquer is tested with true reflection only; no source base darkening, camera changes, displaced capture or forced out-of-frame Buddha reflection. This is not native pixel parity.

materialTransfer: Exported linear PBR colors, all source map/bump/roughness textures, metallic, roughness, transmission and clearcoat parameters. Cycles Principled BSDF is a physical cross-renderer approximation; native GLSL hooks, PMREM cube environment, tone mapping and screen-space reflector are not ported. Actual imported floor reflects actual room geometry through its physical clearcoat.

lightCalibration.sunDirection: Exact exported source direction unless a separately declared verified-upper-window experiment is selected
lightCalibration.practicals: Point source source intensity * 4pi physical power calibration; actual lamp positions retained
lightCalibration.exteriorRadianceCalibration: Exterior daylight strength is an explicitly calibrated boundary, not a measured HDR environment
lightCalibration.toneMap: AgX Medium High Contrast; Three ACESFilmic differs

scopeLimits: Same actual native integration217 source: Sculpture199 J mixed-source NC derivative, closed pierced mandorla205, altar198 with actual carving176/floral157 and brocade201, repaired room, camera189 and actual exterior195 maple. Geometry, matrices, UVs and vertex colors retained without decimation.

Scan-the-World Sainsbury source CC BY-NC-SA4.0 plus peel-3d.com Buddha Head donor173 CC BY4.0; all asset-specific credits and modification notices retained. Neither this artifact nor donor is the reference artifact; no unverified Japanese period assigned to donor.

Source custom procedural GLSL surface hooks, environment maps, sheen and native scattering are not automatically portable. Exported PBR maps are retained; Cycles Principled/AgX and physical air are an explicit independent renderer approximation.
Exact likeness, ornament pattern, proportions and photographic fidelity remain unaccepted.
Exported source-frame.rgba is provenance only, never loaded as scene imagery.
